title: Overview: Quantum Key Satellite Relays
description: Satellites relaying quantum encryption keys across continents — global QKD without trusted fiber nodes. Everything digital rides on networks: faster, more secure, more resilient communication underpins the whole economy. title: Glossary & Quick Reference
description: The working vocabulary of Quantum Key Satellite Relays: Latency, Throughput, Encryption, Zero trust, Failover, Spectrum, QKD, Mesh. Everything digital rides on networks: faster, more secure, more resilient communication underpins the whole economy.
definition: Glossary for Quantum Key Satellite Relays.
key_points: Latency: Network delay — critical for real-time applications.
Throughput: Data rate a link actually delivers.
Encryption: Scrambling data so only key holders read it.
Zero trust: Never trust, always verify — no implicit network trust.
Failover: Automatic switch to backup when primary fails.
Spectrum: Radio frequencies — the shared airwaves.
QKD: Quantum key distribution — keys secured by physics.
Mesh: Network where nodes relay for each other, no single hub.
how_it_works: Learn the terms before the details.
Use the demo as a flash drill.
Add your own terms as you learn.
Teach the vocabulary to your team.
